meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 让Claude接入WhatsApp:自动装好所需组件,引导你扫码或输入配对码把手机号绑成它的号码。绑好后,若用你自己的号码,Claude只出现在与你的自聊里,不读别人消息;若用单独新号,别人也能直接发消息给它。
howto.when: 当你说要给Claude添加WhatsApp,或提到用扫码/配对码连接时触发;它会先做号码安全核对。

say.note: 会先做号码安全核对,再显示二维码

say.text: 用配对码连接,我的号码是14155551234
say.note: 会生成8位配对码,约60秒内输入
会显示共享号码风险警告并要求确认

howto.what_en: Adds WhatsApp to Claude: sets up what's needed and links a phone number via QR or pairing code. On your own number, Claude only chats in your self-chat; on a dedicated number, it can get messages from anyone.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add WhatsApp to Claude, or to link via QR or pairing code.

say_en.text: Add WhatsApp to Claude using the QR method.
say_en.note: Runs the number safety check first, then shows the QR.

say_en.text: Connect with a pairing code; my number is 14155551234.
say_en.note: Shows an 8-character code, expires in about 60 seconds.
Warns about the shared-number risk and asks to confirm.
